description: Dismisses the flap alert (and the flap-monitor-down alert, since reaching 'off' proves the monitor is alive again) once no camera has been over its flap threshold for 30 min. Dismiss-only (no 'recovered' notification) - same churn-avoidance pattern as camera_health_recovered. The 30 min 'for' accounts for the ~1h rolling window decaying slowly after a storm ends. 2026-10-28: the flap card has two tiers, so it is dismissed only when both are clear: cameras_flapping off for 30 min, and the undecryptable-push rate under 4/h with the monitor reporting (the rate present, error null, so a monitor error or an unavailable sensor never counts as clear). Before this, a card raised by the push tier alone was never dismissed, because cameras_flapping was already off and never changed. The check runs on flap_clear, on push_clear (the rate under 4/h for 30 min) and hourly at :11 (sweep): a template trigger arms only from a false render, so after a reload with the rate already low only the sweep can clear the card. The rate itself is read when the check runs, without a hold; the clear bar sits at 4/h, below the alert's 5/h, so a rate hovering at 5/h does not dismiss the card at :11 for the :41 re-assert to raise it again. camera_flap_down is dismissed on flap_clear, as before (reaching off proves the monitor alive), and by the sweep once cameras_flapping has held a real state (on or off) for 30 min: a reload during flap_clear's hold cancels that hold, which used to leave the monitor-down card up while the monitor reported normally.

triggers.value_template: {% set r = state_attr('sensor.camera_flap_rate','push_undecryptable_rate') %}{{ r is not none and state_attr('sensor.camera_flap_rate','error') is none and r | float(0) < 4.0 }}

if.value_template: {% set r = state_attr('sensor.camera_flap_rate','push_undecryptable_rate') %}{{ r is not none and state_attr('sensor.camera_flap_rate','error') is none and r | float(0) < 4.0 }}

{{ trigger.id == 'flap_clear' or (trigger.id == 'sweep' and states('binary_sensor.cameras_flapping') in ['on', 'off'] and now() - states.binary_sensor.cameras_flapping.last_changed > timedelta(minutes=30)) }}
